d0b495257ce81bff68a300e13f17b34f2276b829.sourceText: 坐标、话题、保存开关和Ceres模式在节点配置时读取；3项旧图参数在启动载入入口读取。相关路径没有在参数改动后自动重建订阅、求解器或重新加载旧图的回调；ROS标准use_sim_time由节点时钟机制处理，应与这些启动参数分开理解。
d0b495257ce81bff68a300e13f17b34f2276b829.translatedText: Coordinates, topics, the save switch, and the Ceres mode are read during node configuration; the three legacy map parameters are read at the startup loading entry point\. The relevant paths have no callbacks that automatically rebuild subscriptions, the solver, or reload the legacy map after parameter changes; the ROS standard use_sim_time is handled by the node clock mechanism and should be understood separately from these startup parameters\.
